take.bookTitle: The making of the LEGO Odyssey

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: The drawings came across on the twenty-third of September. Four hundred and thirty drawings and a hundred and fifty-two scenes, as words.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: He means: word to world. A god is a minifigure of real parts. A hall is a piece of a real castle set.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: And every stud of every piece is tested against the piece above it. Five hundred and eighty-two cards the first morning. Eight hundred and sixty-three now.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Helpers. Nine readers at once, six kit builders, a renderer for every queue. Sixty-five in all. I check on them at the top of the hour.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Hi. I'm told I'm the eighth one this week.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: Welcome. Read the last snapshot, and carry on.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Nothing goes out until I've seen the contact sheet.

segments.speaker: firstad
segments.caption: And no take is thrown away.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: The names in the ledger. Watson Hartsoe, eighty-six commits here. Loom Mason, at example dot com, signs the halfworld's, and sixty-nine of its seventy-two say Claude helped.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Quiet on the set. And... action.
